approvals.expected_artifact: This sealed report/spec/tests and exact-head publication proof.
approvals.name: Current public-only requirements review
approvals.prerequisites: Current user instruction, clean baseline and locked public inputs.
approvals.privacy_condition: Declared public docs/static text only; synthetic tests separate.
approvals.stop_condition: No private access, new aggregate or next review execution; finish and STOP.

approvals.expected_artifact: Minimal read-only identity/existence/alignment receipt, only within explicitly granted fields.
approvals.name: Private evidence access
approvals.prerequisites: Separate explicit human grant; exact canonical roots/manifest/candidate-fold-role fields, replica identity and immutable inputs; metadata/array scopes distinguished.
approvals.privacy_condition: No broad scan/discovery; roots and aligned rows private; old execution authorization not reused as a grant.
approvals.stop_condition: Unresolved roots/identities or denied/ungranted scope -> STOP; B never grants C/D/E/F.

approvals.expected_artifact: Only approved deterministic privacy-safe factual aggregates; no policy effect claim.
approvals.name: New privacy-safe aggregate processing
approvals.prerequisites: Separate explicit processing grant plus valid B scope and predeclared questions/grouping/privacy/support/repeat/resume protocol.
approvals.privacy_condition: No raw rows, bins chosen after results, private cutoff disclosure or score-vector publication.
approvals.stop_condition: Missing saved TRAIN gates -> INPUT_INSUFFICIENT; any even-frozen decision application must be explicitly in C scope; no automatic reconstruction or alternate policy.

approvals.expected_artifact: Approved or denied policy specification; no implementation/execution permit implied.
approvals.name: Policy specification/change adoption
approvals.prerequisites: Separate explicit policy approval; exact target, constraints, criteria and locked evidence before any effectiveness test.
approvals.privacy_condition: No sensitive parameters public; retrospective evidence not independent confirmation.
approvals.stop_condition: No new numerical cutoff/calibration/representation acceptance adopted without D; D alone never grants data access, implementation, E or F.

approvals.expected_artifact: Authorized offline evaluation evidence with full22domain accounting, frozen32clauses and both folds.
approvals.name: Scientific execution
approvals.prerequisites: Separate explicit grant for implementation if needed and exact execution functions/inputs/outputs/environment/policy/repeats/capacity/failure rules.
approvals.privacy_condition: Exact private identities and public aggregate projection; no raw/qlog/HOLDOUT or vehicle implicitly.
approvals.stop_condition: No authorization -> no inference, threshold experiment, calibration fit, rollout, selector or candidate validation; required evidence failure aborts/marks insufficiency per approved contract.

approvals.expected_artifact: Separate eligibility/admission receipt or vehicle safety authority receipt, only if later granted.
approvals.name: Independent HOLDOUT and vehicle subauthorities
approvals.prerequisites: Independent admission/untouched-data approval and separate vehicle-specific safety/activation approval; neither implied by A-E or each other.
approvals.privacy_condition: No HOLDOUT discovery/contamination; no vehicle integration by inference from retrospective results.
approvals.stop_condition: Both subauthorities NOT_GRANTED; HOLDOUT CLOSED and vehicle NONE persist.

reviewable_package.minimum_scope: Retrospective TRAIN/DEV saved manifests and exact candidate/fold/role score/label/context/gate identities only; metadata-first scope must be explicit. No historical root guessing or private numeric opening.
